name: Holiday Frosted Sugar Cookies, Butter Shortbread & Snickerdoodles
brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Home Cooking & Local Bakeries (Christmas & Thanksgiving)
whyItWorks: Made strictly from white flour, butter, sugar, eggs, and vanilla/cinnamon—100% free of nuts, coconut shreds, dried fruit, or oats, making them the safest Christmas cookie plate choice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose plain Butter Shortbread, Snickerdoodles, or soft Frosted Sugar Cookies (without lemon/almond extract if citrus-sensitive, and without hard metallic dragée sprinkles).
watchOuts: Skip oatmeal raisin, pecan sandies, macaroons (shredded coconut is high insoluble fiber), and lemon-glazed cookies
